notes.title: Eternal Bonds Devlog - 2
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone![/b]

We are getting closer to launch and today I want to show you the [b]portal mechanic[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45062894/5b253f056538686f8e36a1cb2b634b44b85a187e.gif[/img]

Two portals are always connected to each other. One portal is with the astronaut and the other is with the robot. However, they can only be used to send boxes to the other character. This means that in some levels, you may need to send certain boxes back and forth multiple times.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45062894/d18dee15405720372a539cf392824504387b4367.gif[/img]

The game will release in a few months, so wishlist it right now if you haven't already!
[i]Castical[/i]

notes.title: Eternal Bonds Devlog - 1
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone![/b]

I’m almost done with development, so I wanted to show you some of the different puzzle mechanics in the game.

Let’s take a closer look at the [b]wind mechanic[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45062894/d5fd9ea8b242608b76ee66f2c51af20faab7255c.gif[/img]

When the wind is active, it pushes the player upwards, allowing you to reach higher areas. However, it can also block your path and prevent you from getting back down. To solve these puzzles, you’ll need to enable or disable the wind in the correct order.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45062894/ec3658dc78688eb37cf35177bb5c7f7b487f784c.gif[/img]

In the next devlog, I’ll showcase another exciting mechanic.

Thanks so much for your support,
[i]Castical[/i]

If you want to join the playtest, you can join the playtest discord with the following link:
